name: Sucursal Del Cielo 2019

venue.name: [Sede GANA Santa Ana]
venue.address: Sede GANA, 9 call oriente, Santa Ana, El Salvador.

information: Es una comptencia abierta a toda persona nacional e internacional, cuyo fin es fortalecer y dar a conocer mas acerca del speedcube en esta ciudad, apoyando a la comunidad despeedcuers locales. The competition is open to all, locals and foreigners, the goal of it is to strenghten and popularize cubing in this city, supporting the local community.
